thread:
Clara (product): Quick UX check for the Credentials list actions. Thinking of changing the rotate/revoke affordances to reduce accidental disruption. Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/new-cred-actions
Hank (design): Current problem: users hit Revoke in overflow menu by accident. Proposal: consolidate destructive ops under a single 'Manage' modal with clear sectioning: Overview | Impact | Actions.
Min (backend): API-wise we support single endpoint for actions: POST /v1/keys/:id/manage {action: rotate|soft_revoke|hard_revoke, options:{notify,auto_update}} -> job id. Hard revoke returns 409 if bound to Dedicated infra.
Rosa (security): Recommend two small safeguards: (1) For hard revoke, require typing the key slug; (2) for rotate, show a short 'who will be affected' peek. Default should be Rotate with 'Recommend' label.
Evan (content): Toasts suggested: "Rotation started 12 targets. View progress." and for revoke: "Key disabled. You can undo within 14 days." Also change overflow label from 'Delete' to 'Hard revoke' to reduce ambiguity.
Lina (a11y): Modal must announce role=dialog and describe impact using aria-describedby. For the 'type the key' confirm, ensure label and helper text are read by screenreaders and that validation errors are live-announced.
Hank (design): Mobile notes: overflow menu should surface the safer 'Manage' entry first, not Revoke. The manage modal collapses sections; Impact is collapsed by default. Provide an 'Only show me quick actions' toggle in settings.
Min (backend): Important: when rotate with auto_update=true, we attempt to push secrets to known integrations. This requires write scopes. If some integrations fail, we return partial success and list failures in job details. UI should let user download CSV of new secrets once and instruct copying.
Rosa (security): One more: add rate limits for reveal/rotate endpoints (5/min per actor) and log all rotation events with actor and IP. Expose an audit link in success toast: "Rotation queued View audit" -> opens event.
Evan (content): Microcopy for impact peek: "Estimated impact: X services, Y teams. Some services may require manual updates." For empty state of selection bulk actions: "Select credentials to continue" with disabled button and a short help link.
Lina (a11y): Bulk actions: ensure keyboard multi-select works (shift+click analog), and that select-all has a visible label and aria-checked state. Progress area should use role=status for live updates.
Hank (design): Visual affordance idea: for keys with cross-org exposure show a subtle outline and a 'risk' badge. Clicking it opens the impact panel. Keep colors high contrast and use icons + text.
Min (backend): Edge case: transfer attempt to a team blocked by org policy -> 409 with body {reason: 'policy:block', hint: '/orgs/:id/requests'}. UI should show clear remediation.
log-bot: Event created -> EV-2202223-01, action=rotate, job=JOB-220222-7
Clara (product): Action items: @Hank update modal comps with compact mobile variant, @Evan land microcopy for toasts/peek/empty states, @Lina produce a11y checklist for manage modal and bulk selects, @Min document job responses and CSV one-time link behavior, @Rosa confirm rate limits and required confirmations. Review next Wed. :thumbsup:
